notes.title: 0.5229 version update and studio situation explanation
notes.content:
0.5229 version update and studio situation explanation

Hello players, we apologize for the long interval between this update.
This is because our studio is currently in a difficult situation, with insufficient funds to support its continued operation, resulting in a reduction in the number of people to three.
We will also move to a place with lower costs, so recently we have been busy searching for rental housing, packing items for relocation, handling office termination, and so on.
We have already processed it quickly and will continue to focus on updating the content in the near future.
We believe that 'Pathless Woods' still has a chance to gain recognition from players and will continue to update it. Thank you for your support.

notes.title: 0.52xx major version update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/16c14c88e4339f01d13838d825b3e6ea469cbc09.jpg[/img]

Dear players, since the game was released two months ago, we have received a lot of feedback. We apologize for not providing you with a good experience due to bugs, performance, operation, difficulty, and other issues.
In these two months, although the sales have been very poor, we are still putting in the last bit of resources and time to optimize updates.
In addition to fixing bugs and optimizing performance, we have compiled a relatively large adjustment update based on everyone's feedback, as follows:
Important!! Archive compatibility issue: Due to our remake of the cooking and physique system, the old archive will convert data and the physique will be adjusted to the initial value upon entry.
If you cannot accept it, you can continue running the previous version of the game and choose to do so at startup.
Sorry for any inconvenience caused to you!
1、 The difficulty selection function, in order to meet the needs of different types of players, we have set three levels of difficulty: casual, normal, and difficult. We hope it will be helpful for your gaming experience.
2、 Remake the nutritional system, food buff, and cooking system! Reduce the cost of understanding ingredients and highlight their effectiveness.
3、 Basic interaction optimization, reducing the switching of basic operation buttons, and avoiding E, Misoperation of F key.
4、 Add character information UI and process chain UI, and integrate them with "make", "build", and "help" UI into a large UI.
V Remake NPC upgrade system and add NPC upgrade cultivation line.
6、 Remove the wooden card teleportation function and switch to the Earth Monument teleportation, which can be teleported between the Earth Temple and can be teleported back to the Earth Monument at any location.
7、 Map UI Tag Filter

*8、 Server (simplified version)
Currently, a simplified version of the server has been released, which can be used to improve the issue of low host frame rates when multiple people are online
Usage:
1. Open the server directory and run: Game installation directory/Server/PathlessWoodsServer.exe
2. Create a game after running the server
3. After running the game itself, connect to the server by joining the game
4. At present, the server version has relatively rudimentary functions, which are only suitable for local operation and not suitable for being placed on cloud servers. We will continue to improve the functions in the future.

This is what our small team is currently trying to do to the best of our ability. If there is anything else that makes you very uncomfortable, you can contact us again. We are very sorry, and we will continue to update you continuously in the future.

Email: qyz@aniya.games    alex0524824@126.com

4、 Add character information UI and process chain UI, and integrate them with "make", "build", and "help" UI into a large UI.
V Remake NPC upgrade system and add NPC upgrade cultivation line.

6、 Remove the wooden card teleportation function and switch to the Earth Monument teleportation, which can be teleported between the Earth Temple and can be teleported back to the Earth Monument at any location.

notes.title: Our NEW Demo is Available NOW!
notes.content:
Hey there settlers!

We are excited to announce that the Pathless Woods demo is now live on Steam! This will be a limited-time demo, but rest assured that it will be available for you to play throughout the duration of Steam Next Fest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/422e4c0e7bcd75921d5ae3e8b826d3a5423dd69c.png[/img]
We’ve been taking in your invaluable feedback and suggestions to improve the game since we released the prologue build a few months ago, and are excited to finally share all the new additions with you. 

[h1]Co-op Multiplayer Adventure[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/a460ec80262913a4a0210334172b60839cc1272d.gif[/img]

We’ve expanded the co-op multiplayer experience where you and up to 3 friends can now join together in a shared adventure. You’ll also notice that you can now choose to play as a female settler, complete with character customization options that weren’t included in the prologue build. Collaborate effectively as you explore, build, and survive together, uncovering the secrets of the mysterious land!

[h1]Build Your Own Masterpieces[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/463aee39a827b7abe6dae31c652effa82b61d4e3.gif[/img]

Put your crafting skills to the test and construct a variety of structures that embody the essence of ancient Chinese architecture. From traditional wooden houses to magnificent bridges and even towering pagodas, the possibilities are endless!

[h1]Survive the Wilderness[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/dec44d2249232dd1b1c2a9e21f7b096656d4f65d.gif[/img]

Forge your path, brave the elements, and protect yourself from natural and human threats in a land where survival is a constant challenge. Learn to adapt, utilizing the resources the land provides to stay alive.

[h1]Discover the Unknown[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/75d1d276f7cdc420fed439351cf8acc184ce9a28.gif[/img]

Marvel at the stunning landscapes and interact with friendly NPCs as you uncover the secrets of the ruins. Will you discover hidden treasures and make unexpected discoveries along the way? The adventure awaits!

[h1]Constant Threats[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/5eff15a9984a840f11dcaf33dd5cb09c210c7bbf.gif[/img]

Brace yourself for the constant threat posed by the malicious Jaer cultists, who will stop at nothing to disturb your peace and pillage your resources. Stay vigilant and defend yourself and your allies from their relentless attacks, safeguarding your land and preserving your way of life.

[h1]Farming the Chinese Way[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/aaf06e4b358ffa90703aeeb442c2515d42281217.gif[/img]

Brace yourself for the constant threat posed by the malicious Jaer cultists, who will stop at nothing to disturb your peace and pillage your resources. Stay vigilant and defend yourself and your allies from their relentless attacks, safeguarding your land and preserving your way of life.

There are several other new updates that we’ve added to the game too, but we’ll leave it to you to explore and let us know what you think about them.

We're excited for you to try the demo and would love to hear your thoughts on it. If you have a moment, we would greatly appreciate your help in completing this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdQFMYkuM__ZtxeWMHfj8yXXR0YDjNpdpxQ24MGz5RAPHMSDw/viewform]survey form[/url]. Your feedback is invaluable to us! Should you come across any bugs or have any suggestions, please let us know through this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1XLDExGnPnh8pEqUv7JjVAvl25WAAH_K06nkTlNyScSo/edit]bug report and suggestions form[/url].

In addition, we’re also hosting an exclusive giveaway event where you will stand a chance to win Steam gift cards! Simply follow the actions over on our Twitter page to join and stand a chance to win them. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726130/Pathless_Woods/

If you had a blast playing Pathless Woods, we would be immensely grateful for your support in spreading the word about us! By adding the game to your wishlist and sharing it with your friends, you'll be helping us bring it to a wider audience. We are looking forward to hearing all about your adventures in Pathless Woods!

notes.title: Development Progress & Updates: Issue #4!
notes.content:
Hey Settlers,

We hope you're doing well! As we gear up for Steam Next Fest, we’re excited to share with you the next issue of our Development Progress & Update series. In this update, we’ll be sharing two new things: a new water flow system and implementation of random weather events within the game. 

[h2]New Water Flow System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/e6ffafd00420a6e08cc673fd04a320a332eb1ebe.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/951c28615a79bbea78609f0789c1c0cccace5de7.gif[/img]
First off, we’ve added a new water flow system! With this new feature, you can now dig new water channels to direct water from nearby sources to your land. Whether you’re looking to beautify your home, enhance your environment or improve irrigation for your crops, it’s all made more efficient with realistic water physics. Implementing this feature across different terrains and water sources was a complex task, but it was a rewarding challenge for us!

[h2]Random Weather Events[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/a489f72a0eecc10f0d2b9524f23ad13db32462d1.gif[/img]
Expect an even more exciting and unpredictable gameplay experience with the introduction of random weather events! Just like how one day it might rain and the next could be sunny, we wanted to bring a slice of real-world weather into the game. This also helps us to lay the groundwork for future planned seasonal gameplay mechanics. So remember, always be prepared and build adequate shelter for those unexpected downpours!

We've also been busy optimizing the in-game NPC interactions and upgrading the cooking mechanics. This includes the introduction of various seasonings, a wider range of food choices and more. We believe that these enhancements will make your experience more diverse and enjoyable, and we can’t wait to share more information with you in the upcoming updates.

That's all for issue #4 of our development updates! We're eager to hear your thoughts on these updates. What are you most interested in? What would you like to see in the future? Let us know in the comments below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726130/Pathless_Woods/

We can’t wait to reveal more exciting updates regarding the upcoming Steam Next Fest demo in the coming weeks. If you haven't already, be sure to add Pathless Woods to your wishlist to be instantly notified when the demo is released.

Remember to stay tuned for future updates, and we're looking forward to embarking on the Pathless Woods journey together!

notes.title: Development Progress & Updates: Issue #3!
notes.content:
Hey Settlers!

We hope you are doing well! We’re excited to present you with the next installment of our Development Progress & Update series, and share with you the latest enhancements we've been cooking up.

[h2]New Customization Feature - Display Your Treasures!
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/d8177574ee35a69b204798bd1ca4690fc6be5627.gif[/img]

First off, we want to present a new customization feature in the game. This feature allows you to adorn your favorite furniture with your cherished items, thereby enhancing the homely feel of your virtual living space. Display your most prized collectibles, hard-earned weapons, or curate distinctive decorations. We want to give you the freedom to express your style and personality without inhibition in Pathless Woods.

But that’s not all - there’s more to this update! These decorations aren’t just for display - they’re functional too. For example, wall-mounted lighting not only adds ambience to your space, but also provides much-needed illumination during your nighttime. By integrating form and function, we hope that this will make your gameplay experience more engaging and immersive!

[h2]New Combat Strategies: Bombs & Fireballs!
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/743e86626cd9604645d52690d7fda05278666327.gif[/img]

Brace yourselves, because combat in Pathless Woods just got more exciting! We are shaking things up with new exciting additions to your arsenal of weapons. Get ready to engage in battles that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

First - bombs! They boast a large damage radius, making them ideal for dispersing grouped enemies or gaining an upper hand in challenging fights. However, mastery over these powerful tools demands precision as they are challenging to guide. Keep in mind, possessing such power necessitates thoughtful use. Positioning them strategically is crucial to avoid being caught in the blast yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/e00e89346d120f1fea5c8f4749a82bb0e4ef5272.gif[/img]

Up next, we have fireballs! Imagine encountering a troop of armored foes in the distance, and you know that hand-to-hand combat could be risky. However, there's no need to worry! If you have the right equipment, you can now launch destructive fireballs at your enemies! Be it a formidable unit of heavily-armored opponents or a terrifying beast just outside the range of your blade, you now possess a transformative battle tactic in your arsenal.

We hope these additions will make your combat experience more varied and enjoyable, and give you more strategic options to overcome your foes.

And that wraps up this edition of our development progress update! We're all ears and would love to hear what you think of these new additions, what you're curious about, or what you'd love to see in future updates in the comments below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726130/Pathless_Woods/

If you haven't already, add Pathless Woods to your wishlist to be instantly notified of any new updates, and prepare to immerse yourself in the enchanting aesthetics of traditional China and unravel the mysteries lying within Pathless Woods. Until then, keep exploring, Settlers!

notes.title: Pathless Woods - Development Progress & Updates: Issue #1!
notes.content:
Hey Settlers, welcome back to Pathless Woods! 

In this post, we would like to share some of our development progress in terms of optimizing the in-game models and improving the tutorial playthrough system!

[h2]Improved Graphics Optimization[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/1ec5016e1b4c7d454b872e34c25f54aa8e133dac.gif[/img]
[i]Old game model[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/2d1af0b5167d12d5c5055cccf8474fd6ebba1d45.gif[/img]
[i]New optimized high-resolution model[/i]

As you may know, Pathless Woods is a sandbox game with a vast open world with detailed game models & objects. This would require significant computing power to render them in the game world. During the closed beta testing phase, we've also received feedback from some players about lag and decreased frame rates. As a result, we have been optimizing the game to ensure players have the best possible experience. We've thoroughly modified all game models to reduce their graphical processing demands.

Here is one example of the optimization that we've made! Now, objects that are farther away from the player are shown in lower resolution until the player approaches, at which point the models switch to a more detailed, high-resolution version. This way, there wouldn't be too much processing power required for distant objects, and we believe this will make the gameplay experience much smoother.

[h2]Improved Tutorials[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/c7de2769dffbcef89a731f04888fc264ff031fd0.gif[/img]
[i]Snippets of our new tutorial island![/i]

Next, we've also been working on improving the tutorial systems in the game. Based on feedback from the closed beta testing, the current tutorial island in Pathless Woods is quite complex and has a steep learning curve due to the large amount of tutorial content and branching paths. As such, we have streamlined the tutorials to help players quickly grasp the basic mechanics so that they can dive straight into the world of Pathless Woods! As for the more complex tutorial content, we've decided to move it into the main game, which will allow for an overall smoother gameplay experience! 

[h2]Additional Furniture and Building Content[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/d3ef6e2972724dd4d222bb7fb5378b04bfea7855.gif[/img]

Lastly, we're working on adding a ton of traditional Chinese-style elements to the game such as decorations, furniture and building content. We want to make sure that the game feels authentic and immersive. With a wider range of building options, players can fully express their creativity and design structures that truly embody the culture and architecture of ancient China. In addition, we would love to know what type of decorations you'd like to see in the game as well, so feel free to share your suggestions with us in the comments below!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1726130/Pathless_Woods/

We hope you enjoyed this look into the development progress of Pathless Woods! We're constantly working to improve the game and make it the best it can be, and are committed to regularly updating and sharing our development progress with you. We're always open to feedback and suggestions, so please don't hesitate to reach out to us!

Thanks for your support, and we can't wait for you to explore the mysterious land of Pathless Woods!

notes.title: Pathless Woods Dev Update: Optimizing The Building System!
notes.content:
[b]Hey Settlers! [/b]

As we continue to develop Pathless Woods, we would like to connect and give you a behind-the-scenes look at the development of Pathless Woods through our dev updates!

In this dev update, we'd like to share with you about what we've been working on recently - optimizing the building construction system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/51029c6ced873d6edeb297d6985aaec8b2af691a.png[/img]

If you were previously involved in our closed beta, you would have noticed that there were some issues in the original building construction system such as not having a proper auto-align mode and frequent misalignment issues where players could only use the lines on the ground as a reference for building. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/bc4b0242a09541fec40e6ce60c826abe55f1d6ab.gif[/img]

With Pathless Woods being a game that allows for extensive building and crafting, it was crucial for us to ensure that each building part type had its own specific alignment rules and designs. As such, we have improved the auto-align mode of the building construction system to ensure a smooth experience for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/4306442838063dac14c90b824e03478bef53c041.png[/img]

With these improvements, building on uneven terrain and adding tiles to roofs will be easier and more precise, allowing players to express their creativity and build their own world without limits. No more worrying about "shaky hands" ruining your creations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483423/037910bb1f5dae2a477bbbb4e33fe858dd72bfdb.png[/img]

As we continue on our journey to make the Pathless Woods gaming experience better for everyone, the next steps ahead for us would be focusing on updating the in-game interaction interface and adding new and exciting features. Although we can't reveal all the details just yet, we are confident that the improvements we are making to the interface and character movements will result in a more convenient and immersive experience for players.

And with that, we wrap up this installment of our development progress for Pathless Woods! We would love to hear from you and know what else you're curious about in our game. Feel free to reach out to us through various channels, and we'll be happy to answer any questions you may have!

[url=https://twitter.com/PathlessWoods1]Pathless Woods Twitter[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/JskQ3t59VH]Pathless Woods Discord[/url]
